'''2009 2K Event Day 1 Joe Giannetti LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Giannetti]] at [[2009 2K Event]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Jigga
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
